projects.name: Design System Migration
projects.description: Led migration from legacy component library to modern design system, reducing bundle size by 40% and improving developer productivity across 12 product teams.

summaryBlocks.content: Engineering leader with 10+ years scaling teams from startup to growth stage, combining deep technical expertise in frontend systems with strategic thinking on organizational design.

stories.title: Design System Migration Leadership
stories.situation: Our legacy component library was causing 40% of front-end bugs and slowing feature development by 30%. Teams were duplicating components inconsistently.
stories.task: Lead the migration to a modern design system while maintaining feature velocity and gaining buy-in from 12 product teams.
stories.action: Created a phased migration plan with backwards compatibility. Established design tokens, documented component APIs, and paired with team leads to address concerns. Ran weekly office hours.
stories.result: Completed migration in 6 months with zero production incidents. Reduced front-end bugs by 60%, cut new feature development time by 25%, and achieved 95% adoption across teams.

variants.action: Implemented a codemods-based migration strategy with AST transformations. Built a Storybook-driven testing harness to validate visual regression. Created TypeScript strict mode wrapper components for type safety during transition.

communication.customGuidelines: Prefer concrete examples over buzzwords. Lead with outcomes.
